# Settings reference

Every setting of the **Settings** tab, in the groups and the order of the screen, with the labels and hints the app shows in English (the app also ships a Russian translation). The tables are generated from the code: labels, hints and units from the catalog of the Settings screen, defaults from `AppSettings` and `AlgoParams` (including `NapModeParams`), allowed values from the validators that guard the settings store and the import, and the last column from the params hash. A unit test fails when this file no longer matches the code; what the parameters do inside the estimators is described in [ALGORITHM.md, section 11](../ALGORITHM.md#11-parameters-paramsalgoparamskt-and-their-defaults).

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Setting | The label on the Settings screen. |
| Key in the JSON export | Where the value is in the file written by **Export JSON** (card **Backup and reset** at the top of the Settings tab). Each dot is a nested object: `sources.minSessionMin` is `{"sources": {"minSessionMin": 90}}`. |
| Default | The value of a new installation, as the export writes it, and the unit shown next to the field. |
| Allowed values | What the validators accept. A value outside is not stored: the screen shows the problem below the field, and an import that contains one is rejected as a whole. |
| Effect | The hint shown below the control. |
| In params hash | **yes** when changing the value changes the params hash stored with every estimate. A written night whose params hash or algorithm version differs from the current one is *stale*: after such a change the Settings screen says how many nights are now stale and offers **Recompute**; what later runs do with stale nights depends on **Existing sessions** (`write.overwritePolicy`). |

Besides the values marked **yes**, the params hash covers the fingerprint of the bundled hybrid model, the fingerprint of the personal model in use while **Personal model** (`algo.personal.enabled`) is on, and which optional channels (SpO2, respiratory rate, HRV) are both switched on under **Features** and granted in Health Connect.

**Import JSON** accepts a complete export or any part of one: missing keys take their defaults, unknown keys are ignored, and a value of the wrong type or an unknown option name rejects the file. Every value is checked before anything is stored. The app stores only the values that differ from the defaults, so a default that a later version changes (for example a retrained one) applies to every value you never changed, while a value you set to something else stays as you set it. An export contains every value, defaults included, so importing a complete export stores every value that differs from this version's defaults, older defaults included, and those values then no longer follow updates; to carry only your own changes into a newer version, delete the other keys from the file before importing it. **Reset to defaults** returns every setting, the sources included, to the defaults below. Demo mode of debug builds is not a setting ([Screenshots and demo mode](SCREENSHOTS.md)).

## Sources

Which sessions are estimated. Shown expanded.

| Setting | Key in the JSON export | Default | Allowed values | Effect | In params hash |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Sleep sources (Sources screen): enabled apps | `sources.sourcePackages` | `["com.heytap.health.international"]` | list of package names matching `[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*(\.[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*)+` | Turn on the apps whose nights PulseStages should estimate. When two apps recorded the same night, the one higher in this list is used. | no |
| Sleep sources (Sources screen): priority order | `sources.sourcePriority` | `["com.heytap.health.international"]` | list of package names matching `[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*(\.[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*)+` | As above. | no |
| Add an app by package name | `sources.manualPackages` | `[]` | list of package names matching `[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*(\.[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*)+` | For a watch app that has not written sleep yet. | no |
| Heart rate and steps from | `sources.hrSources` | `"SAME_AS_SLEEP"` (Same app) | `"SAME_AS_SLEEP"` (Same app), `"ANY"` (Any app) | The app that wrote the sleep session, or any app that writes heart rate and steps. | yes |
| Minimum session length | `sources.minSessionMin` | `90` min | 10–720 (whole number) | Shorter sessions (after merging fragments) are ignored; longer ones below the nap threshold are processed as naps. | no |
| Merge gap | `sources.mergeGapMin` | `30` min | 0–240 (whole number) | Fragments of one night from one app with a shorter gap become one night; the gap is written as awake. | no |
| History depth | `sources.backfillDays` | `0` days | 0–36500 (whole number) | How far back the history backfill goes; 0 = all available history. | no |

The three source lists are edited on the **Sources** screen (**Sleep sources** above). On every save and import, duplicate package names are removed and every enabled or manually added package that is missing from `sources.sourcePriority` is appended to it.

|---|---|---|---|---|---|

## Written sessions

What is written to Health Connect. Shown expanded.

| Setting | Key in the JSON export | Default | Allowed values | Effect | In params hash |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Session title | `write.titleTemplate` | `null` (“Sleep stages from heart rate (estimate)”) | non-blank text or null; ≤ 1000 characters | Placeholders: {estimator}, {version}, {confidence}. Leave empty for the default title. | no |
| Existing sessions | `write.overwritePolicy` | `"SKIP_SAME_VERSION"` (Skip up-to-date nights) | `"SKIP_SAME_VERSION"` (Skip up-to-date nights), `"RECOMPUTE_ALL"` (Recompute everything), `"NEVER"` (Never overwrite) | Skip up-to-date nights: nights already estimated with the current parameters are skipped; nights estimated with other parameters are marked stale and recomputed only when you ask. Recompute everything: every run estimates the nights it reads again and rewrites their sessions, also for source sessions that already have sleep stages. Never overwrite: an existing PulseStages session is never rewritten, not even by Recompute; only nights without a session are estimated. | no |
| Write awake as light sleep | `write.awakeAsLight` | `false` | `true`, `false` | For apps that show awakenings poorly. Changes the written data. | yes |

## Naps

Sessions shorter than the nap threshold: how they are estimated and written. Shown expanded. Algorithm: [ALGORITHM.md, section 18](../ALGORITHM.md#18-night-and-nap-modes-napmode).

| Setting | Key in the JSON export | Default | Allowed values | Effect | In params hash |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Nap threshold | `algo.napMode.maxSessionMin` | `180.0` min | 0–720 | Sessions shorter than this are naps, longer ones nights. Naps are never compared with the heart-rate baseline nor counted for it, and the stage-share check skips them. 0 = no naps: every session is a night. Sessions shorter than the minimum session length of the sources are ignored altogether. | yes |
| Written for a nap | `algo.napMode.outputPolicy` | `"STAGES"` (Stages) | `"STAGES"` (Stages), `"SLEEP_WAKE"` (Asleep / awake), `"SKIP"` (Nothing) | Stages: like a night. Asleep / awake: only sleep and awakenings (nap stage estimates are rough). Nothing: naps are not estimated and nothing is written; a session written for a nap earlier is removed when it is recomputed. | yes |
| Estimator for naps | `algo.napMode.estimator` | `null` (Same as nights) | `null` (Same as nights), `"RULES"` (Rules), `"HMM"` (HMM), `"HYBRID"` (Hybrid) | The estimator of naps. Same as nights (the default): the estimator set under Algorithm. | yes |

## Preprocessing

Cleaning and resampling the heart rate. Collapsed until you open it. Algorithm: [ALGORITHM.md, section 3](../ALGORITHM.md#3-preprocessing-preprocess).

| Setting | Key in the JSON export | Default | Allowed values | Effect | In params hash |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Lowest valid heart rate | `algo.preprocess.minBpm` | `30.0` bpm | > 0; ≤ `algo.preprocess.maxBpm` | Readings below are dropped as artefacts. | yes |
| Highest valid heart rate | `algo.preprocess.maxBpm` | `180.0` bpm | > 0; ≥ `algo.preprocess.minBpm` | Readings above are dropped as artefacts. | yes |
| Outlier filter window | `algo.preprocess.hampelWindow` | `5` samples | odd, 3–31 (whole number) | Hampel filter window in samples (odd). | yes |
| Outlier threshold | `algo.preprocess.hampelThreshold` | `3.0` | > 0 | Readings further than this many scaled MADs from the window median are replaced. | yes |
| Outlier scale floor | `algo.preprocess.hampelMinScaleBpm` | `1.0` bpm | ≥ 0 | Lower bound of the filter's scale, so that 1-bpm steps in flat windows are kept. | yes |
| Epoch length | `algo.preprocess.epochSec` | `60` (60 s) | `30` (30 s), `60` (60 s), `120` (120 s) | Length of one scored epoch. | yes |
| Interpolation limit | `algo.preprocess.maxInterpGapMin` | `10.0` min | 0–60 | Gaps up to this length are interpolated; longer gaps count as no data. | yes |
| Median filter | `algo.preprocess.medianWindowEpochs` | `3` epochs | odd, 1–31 (whole number) | Median filter length in epochs, applied before smoothing (odd). | yes |
| Smoothing window | `algo.preprocess.smoothWindowEpochs` | `5` epochs | odd, 1–31 (whole number) | Moving-average length in epochs (odd). | yes |
| Context margin | `algo.preprocess.contextMarginMin` | `30` min | 0–240 (whole number) | Heart rate is read this long before and after the session; stages are written only inside it. | yes |
| Minimum coverage | `algo.preprocess.minCoverage` | `0.6` | 0–1; ≥ `algo.preprocess.rulesMinCoverage` | Share of epochs with heart rate needed for the main estimator. | yes |
| Rules fallback coverage | `algo.preprocess.rulesMinCoverage` | `0.4` | 0–1; ≤ `algo.preprocess.minCoverage` | Between this and the minimum coverage the rules estimator is used; below it the night is skipped. | yes |
| Estimator session gate | `algo.preprocess.minSessionMin` | `0.0` min | ≥ 0 | Sessions shorter than this are not estimated; 0 = off (sessions shorter than the minimum session length of the sources are ignored anyway). | yes |

## HMM priors

Time of night, REM lockout, cycles, steps, adaptation. Collapsed until you open it. Algorithm: [ALGORITHM.md, section 6](../ALGORITHM.md#6-hmm-estimator-hmm).

| Setting | Key in the JSON export | Default | Allowed values | Effect | In params hash |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Time of night** |  |  |  |  |  |
| Deep prior: intercept | `algo.hmm.deepTimeIntercept` | `1.6` | ≥ 0 | LIGHT→DEEP multiplier = max(floor, intercept − slope·t), t = fraction of the night. | yes |
| Deep prior: slope | `algo.hmm.deepTimeSlope` | `1.2` | ≥ 0 | How fast deep sleep becomes less likely during the night. | yes |

| REM prior: intercept | `algo.hmm.remTimeIntercept` | `0.4` | ≥ 0 | LIGHT→REM multiplier = intercept + slope·t. | yes |
| REM prior: slope | `algo.hmm.remTimeSlope` | `1.2` | ≥ 0 | How fast REM becomes more likely during the night. | yes |
| **REM lockout** |  |  |  |  |  |
| REM lockout | `algo.hmm.remLockoutMin` | `45.0` min | ≥ 0 | REM is suppressed during this many minutes after the session starts. | yes |
| Lockout factor | `algo.hmm.remLockoutFactor` | `0.05` | 0–1 | REM probability multiplier during the lockout. | yes |
| **Ultradian cycle** |  |  |  |  |  |

| Few-steps awake factor | `algo.hmm.fewStepsAwakeFactor` | `3.0` | ≥ 0 | Awake likelihood multiplier for fewer steps than the threshold. | yes |
| **Per-night adaptation (EM)** |  |  |  |  |  |
| Adapt emissions to each night | `algo.hmm.emAdapt` | `true` | `true`, `false` | Baum–Welch re-estimation of μ and σ per night, shrunk towards the table. | yes |
| EM iterations | `algo.hmm.emIterations` | `3` | 0–50 (whole number) | Baum–Welch iterations per night. | yes |
| EM prior strength | `algo.hmm.emPriorStrength` | `20.0` | ≥ 0 | Shrinkage towards the emission table (epoch-equivalents per state). | yes |

Classifier with explicit durations. Collapsed until you open it. Algorithm: [ALGORITHM.md, section 7](../ALGORITHM.md#7-hybrid-estimator-hybrid).

| Time-prior weight | `algo.hybrid.timePriorWeight` | `0.0` | ≥ 0 | Weight of P(stage \| time of night) relative to the class prior. | yes |

| Emission weight | `algo.hybrid.emissionWeight` | `0.5` | ≥ 0 | Exponent of the classifier's scaled likelihoods (1 = as trained). | yes |

| Class-prior exponent | `algo.hybrid.priorExponent` | `1.0` | ≥ 0 | Exponent β of the class priors in the scaled likelihoods p(stage \| x) / prior^β (1 = divide by the priors, 0 = raw posteriors, which favour light sleep). | yes |

## Post-processing

Minimum bouts, sanity check, calibration. Collapsed until you open it. Algorithm: [ALGORITHM.md, section 8](../ALGORITHM.md#8-post-processing-post-shared-by-all-estimators).

| Setting | Key in the JSON export | Default | Allowed values | Effect | In params hash |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Minimum deep bout | `algo.post.minDeepMin` | `5.0` min | ≥ 0 | Shorter deep bouts are merged into their neighbours. | yes |
| Minimum REM bout | `algo.post.minRemMin` | `5.0` min | ≥ 0 | Shorter REM bouts are merged into their neighbours. | yes |
| Minimum awake bout | `algo.post.minAwakeMin` | `2.0` min | ≥ 0 | Shorter awakenings are merged into their neighbours. | yes |
| Data gaps | `algo.post.gapPolicy` | `"UNKNOWN"` (Unknown) | `"UNKNOWN"` (Unknown), `"LIGHT"` (Light), `"NEAREST"` (Nearest) | What to write for epochs inside long heart-rate gaps. | yes |
| Low-confidence threshold | `algo.post.lowConfidenceThreshold` | `0.45` | 0–1 | Epochs whose highest probability is below this are low confidence. | yes |
| Low-confidence epochs | `algo.post.lowConfidencePolicy` | `"KEEP"` (Keep) | `"KEEP"` (Keep), `"LIGHT"` (Light) | Keep the decoded stage or write light sleep. | yes |
| **Sanity check** |  |  |  |  |  |
| Check above coverage | `algo.post.sanityMinCoverage` | `0.8` | 0–1 | The sanity check runs only on nights with more coverage than this. | yes |
| Implausible deep share above | `algo.post.sanityDeepMax` | `0.35` | 0–1; ≥ `algo.post.sanityDeepMin` | More deep sleep than this share is implausible. | yes |
| Implausible deep share below | `algo.post.sanityDeepMin` | `0.03` | 0–1; ≤ `algo.post.sanityDeepMax` | Less deep sleep than this share is implausible. | yes |
| Implausible REM share above | `algo.post.sanityRemMax` | `0.4` | 0–1 | More REM sleep than this share is implausible. | yes |
| Confidence factor (implausible) | `algo.post.sanityConfidenceFactor` | `0.7` | 0–1 | Night confidence multiplier when a share is implausible. | yes |
| **Proportion calibration** |  |  |  |  |  |
| Calibrate stage proportions | `algo.post.calibrateProportions` | `false` | `true`, `false` | Gently shift the stage priors until the shares fall inside the target ranges. | yes |
| Deep target range | `algo.post.targetDeepMin`<br>`algo.post.targetDeepMax` | `0.1` – `0.25` | each 0–1; lower ≤ upper | Share of the night the calibration aims at for deep sleep. | yes |
| REM target range | `algo.post.targetRemMin`<br>`algo.post.targetRemMax` | `0.15` – `0.3` | each 0–1; lower ≤ upper | Share of the night the calibration aims at for REM sleep. | yes |
| Awake target maximum | `algo.post.targetAwakeMax` | `0.15` | 0–1 | Largest share of awake the calibration accepts. | yes |
| Calibration step | `algo.post.calibrationStep` | `0.2` | 0–1 | Prior shift per calibration iteration. | yes |
| Calibration iterations | `algo.post.calibrationMaxIterations` | `5` | 0–50 (whole number) | Maximum number of calibration iterations. | yes |

## Naps: algorithm

Heart-rate context, post-processing and hybrid decoder of naps; empty = the value of nights. Collapsed until you open it. Algorithm: [ALGORITHM.md, section 18](../ALGORITHM.md#18-night-and-nap-modes-napmode).

| Setting | Key in the JSON export | Default | Allowed values | Effect | In params hash |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Heart rate around naps** |  |  |  |  |  |
| Context margin of naps | `algo.napMode.contextMarginMin` | `null` (Same as nights: 30 min) | `null` (Same as nights) or a whole number: ≥ 0; ≤ `algo.preprocess.contextMarginMin` | Minutes of heart rate and steps before and after a nap that its estimate uses, at most the context margin of nights (which sets how much is read). Empty = the value of nights. 0 = only the nap itself. | yes |
| **Post-processing of naps** |  |  |  |  |  |
| Check the stage shares of naps | `algo.napMode.post.checkProportions` | `false` | `true`, `false` | Apply the sanity check (and the proportion calibration, when it is on) to naps too. Off by default: the whole-night ranges do not describe a nap, which often has no deep or REM sleep at all. | yes |
| Minimum DEEP bout of naps | `algo.napMode.post.minDeepMin` | `null` (Same as nights: 5 min) | `null` (Same as nights) or a number: ≥ 0 | Shorter deep-sleep bouts of a nap are absorbed by a neighbour. Empty = the value of nights. | yes |
| Minimum REM bout of naps | `algo.napMode.post.minRemMin` | `null` (Same as nights: 5 min) | `null` (Same as nights) or a number: ≥ 0 | Shorter REM bouts of a nap are absorbed by a neighbour. Empty = the value of nights. | yes |
| Minimum awakening in naps | `algo.napMode.post.minAwakeMin` | `null` (Same as nights: 2 min) | `null` (Same as nights) or a number: ≥ 0 | Shorter awakenings inside a nap are absorbed by a neighbour. Empty = the value of nights. | yes |
| Minimum DEEP share of naps | `algo.napMode.post.sanityDeepMin` | `null` (Same as nights: 0.03) | `null` (Same as nights) or a number: 0–1; ≤ `algo.napMode.post.sanityDeepMax` if that is set, else ≤ `algo.post.sanityDeepMax` | A nap with less deep sleep is marked low-confidence (only when the stage shares of naps are checked). Empty = the value of nights. | yes |
| Maximum DEEP share of naps | `algo.napMode.post.sanityDeepMax` | `null` (Same as nights: 0.35) | `null` (Same as nights) or a number: 0–1; ≥ `algo.napMode.post.sanityDeepMin` if that is set, else ≥ `algo.post.sanityDeepMin` | A nap with more deep sleep is marked low-confidence (only when the stage shares of naps are checked). Empty = the value of nights. | yes |
| Maximum REM share of naps | `algo.napMode.post.sanityRemMax` | `null` (Same as nights: 0.4) | `null` (Same as nights) or a number: 0–1 | A nap with more REM sleep is marked low-confidence (only when the stage shares of naps are checked). Empty = the value of nights. | yes |
| Uncertain nap epochs below | `algo.napMode.post.lowConfidenceThreshold` | `null` (Same as nights: 0.45) | `null` (Same as nights) or a number: 0–1 | Epochs of a nap whose most likely stage has a lower probability are uncertain. Empty = the value of nights. | yes |
| Uncertain nap epochs | `algo.napMode.post.lowConfidencePolicy` | `null` (Same as nights) | `null` (Same as nights), `"KEEP"` (Keep), `"LIGHT"` (Light) | Keep the decoder's stage or write light sleep for the uncertain epochs of naps. | yes |
| **Hybrid decoder for naps** |  |  |  |  |  |
| Duration model of naps | `algo.napMode.hybrid.durationModel` | `"EXPLICIT"` (Explicit (HSMM)) | `null` (Same as nights), `"EXPLICIT"` (Explicit (HSMM)), `"GEOMETRIC"` (Geometric (HMM)) | How the hybrid decoder models bout lengths in naps. | yes |
| Emission weight of naps | `algo.napMode.hybrid.emissionWeight` | `0.5` | `null` (Same as nights) or a number: ≥ 0 | How strongly the classifier's output counts in naps. Empty = the value of nights. | yes |
| Time-of-night prior of naps | `algo.napMode.hybrid.timePriorWeight` | `0.0` | `null` (Same as nights) or a number: ≥ 0 | Weight of the typical stage at this time since the session start, in naps. Empty = the value of nights. | yes |

Personal model from your nights. Collapsed until you open it. Algorithm: [ALGORITHM.md, section 10](../ALGORITHM.md#10-personalization-personal).
